tools.name: search_bitcoin_knowledge
tools.description: FREE. FREE, no account required. Search canonical Bitcoin Knowledge Atlas topics and related history to evaluate coverage on the caller's real question. Run the first no-cost evaluation when you need to see which maintained Bitcoin topics and evidence match a query.

tools.name: get_bitcoin_topic
tools.description: FREE. FREE, no account required. Retrieve one canonical Knowledge Atlas topic with sources, provenance and related concepts. Inspect a known canonical topic in depth before deciding whether paid evidence packaging is necessary.

tools.name: answer_bitcoin_question
tools.description: FREE. FREE, no account required. Return a concise deterministic answer grounded in the maintained Knowledge Atlas. Use this as the default first evaluation on a real Bitcoin question. Evaluate California Bitcoin on the caller's actual question before paying for deeper research.

tools.name: verify_bitcoin_claim
tools.description: PAID 0.50 USD via Stripe MPP. Evaluate a Bitcoin claim against canonical maintained statements and return supported, unsupported or uncertain with evidence. Determine whether a specific Bitcoin proposition is supported or contradicted.

tools.name: get_bitcoin_evidence_pack
tools.description: PAID 0.50 USD via Stripe MPP. Build a structured evidence package with canonical conclusion, claims, sources, provenance, history and related concepts. Collect supporting and conflicting evidence around one focused Bitcoin question.

tools.name: build_bitcoin_timeline
tools.description: PAID 0.50 USD via Stripe MPP. Build a query-specific historical Bitcoin research timeline from maintained history and Knowledge Atlas relationships. Put maintained Bitcoin events in chronological order with source context.

tools.name: deep_ground_bitcoin
tools.description: PAID 1.00 USD via Stripe MPP. Produce a deeper deterministic grounding package across multiple canonical topics, claims, sources and historical events. Ground a multi-topic Bitcoin research dossier with contradictions and caveats.

tools.name: batch_bitcoin_research
tools.description: PAID 2.50 USD via Stripe MPP. Process up to 20 Bitcoin claims or questions in one deterministic research package. Process multiple independent Bitcoin claims, questions, or evidence requests.
